STICKYNOTES.Title: Sticky Note
STICKYNOTES.ScopeHint: A shared note is visible to everyone. Only you or the GM can change one you wrote.
STICKYNOTES.LockedShared: {name} wrote the party note on this. You can still keep your own private note.
STICKYNOTES.SharedSaved: Party note saved — everyone can see it.
STICKYNOTES.NoGM: No GM is online, so a party note can't be saved right now. Save it as private instead.
STICKYNOTES.SettingShowMarkersHint: Display a small corner dot on any token or tile that has a note.
STICKYNOTES.SettingHoverDelayHint: How long to hover before the note appears. 0 shows it immediately.
STICKYNOTES.SettingEnabledHint: Turn the whole module's UI on or off for you.
STICKYNOTES.PlaceHint: Click the map to drop a sticky note pin. Esc to cancel.
STICKYNOTES.KeyNoteHint: Open the sticky-note editor for the token or tile under the cursor (or the selected token).
STICKYNOTES.KeyPinHint: Arm pin placement, then click the map.
STICKYNOTES.SettingRegionButtonsHint: Regions have no right-click HUD, so by default you right-click a region to summon its sticky-note button. Turn this on to show a button on every region while the Regions layer is active instead.
STICKYNOTES.NoDrawingPerm: You don't have permission to create drawings, so you can't place a pin. Ask your GM to enable Create Drawings for your role.
STICKYNOTES.SettingAnyLayerHint: Foundry normally only lets you hover an object while its own layer is active. With this on, notes appear no matter which tool is selected.
